reason: A toolchain is available (axoloty-dev:latest, Swift 6.3.3 / ESP-IDF v5.4) and the firmware image builds, but no physical ESP32-C6 is attached to AXOLOTY_DEVICE_PORT and no MQTT broker is reachable, so the smoke protocol could not be flashed or run. A container can produce an image; it cannot flash one. Axoloty 0.8.2 started a new compatibility cycle on 827e598f3d97 and this profile has no device evidence for it, so it stays unqualified. The 0.8.2 image is bit-identical to the 0.8.1 artifact, but that does not qualify the new revision.
